# SPDX 2.3 JSON schema test fixture

`spdx-2.3-schema.json` is a whitespace-compacted, otherwise unmodified copy of
the SPDX 2.3 JSON schema from commit
`aadf3b0b8dbbabdb4d880b0fc714255fea436ff7` (the dereferenced `v2.3` tag):

https://github.com/spdx/spdx-spec/blob/aadf3b0b8dbbabdb4d880b0fc714255fea436ff7/schemas/spdx-schema.json

The upstream unformatted file has SHA-256
`239208b7ac287b3cf5d9a9af23f9d69863971102a5e1587a27a398b43490b89b`.
This compact fixture has SHA-256
`11cd94e7b41ae669d42dedc68448d1899cf27b862bce8a5c7f590de693270048`.
